name: com.gameframex.unity.operationclipboard.douyinminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Clipboard (DouYin Mini Game)
description:
DouYin Mini Game clipboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationClipboard. Self-registers into OperationClipboardRegistry at startup via DouYinMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD macros are not enabled; installation implies registration).

GameFrameX OperationClipboard 的抖音小游戏粘贴板适配渠道包。通过 DouYinMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap 在启动阶段自注册进主包 OperationClipboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪，注册不会发生；引用即注册）。
